home.recognitionTitle: Learn English for the moments you actually need to speak.
home.recognitionDescription: EngliTutor helps A2–B1 learners turn passive knowledge into daily workplace and interview practice.
home.recognitionNote: Each lesson is short, guided, and benefit-driven: understand the context, speak out loud, then review what to improve in Vietnamese.
home.sampleTitle: A clear 20–30 minute loop from input to confident output.
home.sampleDescription: One topic runs through the whole session, so every step prepares you for the next one.

learnerNeeds.title: Speak clearly when work gets real
learnerNeeds.body: Practice the exact moments that matter: stand-ups, client calls, interviews, and project updates.

learnerNeeds.title: Get useful feedback fast
learnerNeeds.body: See what to fix after you try: grammar, pronunciation, vocabulary, and a more natural answer.

learnerNeeds.title: Build a daily habit
learnerNeeds.body: Short sessions keep English active without asking you to sit through a long course after work.

learnerNeeds.title: Understand mistakes in Vietnamese
learnerNeeds.body: Vietnamese explanations help you notice why a sentence sounds wrong and how to say it better next time.

sessionBeats.title: Listen for the situation
sessionBeats.detail: Hear a short workplace or interview prompt and catch the main task, keywords, and tone.

sessionBeats.title: Read the context
sessionBeats.detail: Scan an email, job description, or short brief so your answer has the right details.

sessionBeats.title: Speak with the AI tutor
sessionBeats.detail: Answer follow-up questions out loud, then retry with clearer grammar and pronunciation.

sessionBeats.title: Write and review
sessionBeats.detail: Write a short summary or reply; get Vietnamese feedback and a natural rewrite to practice aloud.

skillPath.focus: Catch meaning in meetings and calls
skillPath.practice: Short clips, stand-ups, customer questions, and interview prompts.
skillPath.outcome: Follow the main idea, key requirements, and next actions with less pausing.

skillPath.practice: Scenario conversations for introductions, projects, decisions, and behavioral questions.
skillPath.outcome: Give clearer A2–B1 answers and retry after pronunciation and grammar feedback.

skillPath.practice: Emails, job descriptions, short docs, and lesson notes with vocabulary in context.
skillPath.outcome: Find the useful details without translating every word.

skillPath.practice: Write short updates, summaries, and interview answers after each speaking task.
skillPath.outcome: Use better tense, word choice, and sentence order in practical writing.

home.illustrativePreview: Illustrative lesson preview — not a live conversation.
home.skillsTitle: Listening, speaking, reading, and writing in one practical path.
home.skillsDescription: Placement checks all four skills. Lessons then connect them around situations you can use at work or in interviews.

whyItems.title: One topic, four skills
whyItems.body: Listening, reading, speaking, and writing reinforce the same situation instead of becoming separate drills.

whyItems.title: Feedback after action
whyItems.body: You try first, then receive Vietnamese explanations and improved phrasing you can immediately repeat.

whyItems.title: Practice follows weak spots
whyItems.body: Common errors such as tense, s/es, collocation, or missed keywords can carry into the next session.

home.whyTitle: Practice is easier to repeat when every lesson has a job.

useCasesItems.title: Before a project interview
useCasesItems.body: Practice explaining your role, the problem, your solution, and what you learned — then tighten the answer.

useCasesItems.title: Before a weekly meeting
useCasesItems.body: Rehearse a status update, answer follow-up questions, and turn your notes into a short written summary.

home.useCasesTitle: Choose a real situation, then practice the English around it.
home.useCasesDescription: These are examples of how learners can use EngliTutor — not testimonials or guaranteed outcomes.
home.pricingTitle: Start free. Upgrade when you need more AI tutor time.
home.pricingNote: Prices and plan benefits come from the live billing catalog. The cards below keep the real plan data and actions intact.

faqItems.q: I'm A2 and weak at speaking — can I start?
faqItems.a: Yes. The placement test covers listening, speaking, reading, and writing, then your path starts at the right level. You still practice all four skills, including the weak ones.
Every session connects speaking with listening, reading, and a short writing task. Speaking gets focused time, but the input and review make your answers stronger.
Plan for about 20–30 minutes for a complete loop: listen, read, speak with AI, then write and review feedback in Vietnamese.

faqItems.q: How is Free different from paid plans?
faqItems.a: Free lets you try the daily learning loop with limited AI tutor usage. Paid plans use the live billing catalog shown above, so the exact price and included benefits stay up to date.

faqItems.q: What happens to my speaking audio?
faqItems.a: Short clips are sent to speech providers so we can transcribe you and play tutor audio back. We do not sell your voice or transcripts.
Session cookies keep you signed in. Preference storage on your device remembers theme and playback settings. We do not run advertising cookies.
